title: Sprnt
tagline: SRPNT is a non-custodial, AI-powered perpetual futures trading platform on ETH.
description: SRPNT is a non-custodial AI perps trading platform on ETH. Describe your strategy in plain English, pick a persona (Degen/CFO/Quant), set hard risk limits, and deploy a Hermes Agent that trades 24/7. Agent wallets can trade but never withdraw. Risk guardrails enforced at execution layer.
how_its_made: Next.js 15 + Hono API + Prisma/Postgres, with Python Hermes Agents in Docker. LLM calls one MCP tool that runs every order through a risk guard (position/leverage/drawdown caps) before signing. Hand-rolled Jupiter Perps instruction encoding since the official SDK is still WIP......
